title: What Do Americans Say at the New Year? (1/2)
titleZh: 美國人過新年時都說些什麼？ (1/2)
summaryZh: 介紹美國人在新年賀卡上常寫的祝福語，像是健康、順利與平安。
source: VOA Learning English (public domain) — Ask a Teacher

sentences.text: This week, we answer a question from Maria in Brazil.
sentences.zh: 這禮拜我們要回答巴西的 Maria 提出的問題。

sentences.text: I am sending some cards to my American friends.
sentences.zh: 我要寄一些卡片給我的美國朋友。

sentences.text: I'd like to know what to write on the cards for the new year.
sentences.zh: 我想知道新年的時候卡片上可以寫些什麼。

sentences.text: Maria, Brazil Dear Maria, thank you for writing to us.
sentences.zh: 巴西的 Maria。親愛的 Maria，謝謝你寫信給我們。

sentences.text: In many countries, people send messages at the end of the year or the beginning of the year with greetings and good wishes.
sentences.zh: 在很多國家，大家會在年底或年初傳訊息，送上問候和祝福。

sentences.text: A popular wish that you will see on a New Year's greeting card is for good health.
sentences.zh: 新年賀卡上常見的一種祝福，就是祝人身體健康。

sentences.text: Wishing you a healthy and happy New Year.
sentences.zh: 祝你新的一年健康又快樂。

sentences.text: Another popular wish is for happiness and wealth or prosperity.
sentences.zh: 另一種常見的祝福是祝人幸福、富足或事業興旺。

sentences.text: We wish you a prosperous and joyful New Year.
sentences.zh: 祝你新的一年順遂又開心。

sentences.text: Another wish you can write on your cards is for peace and joy for your friends.
sentences.zh: 還有一種可以寫在卡片上的祝福，是祝朋友平安喜樂。

sentences.text: Hoping that your New Year is filled with joy and peace.
sentences.zh: 希望你的新年充滿喜悅與平安。

sentences.text: As the New Year starts, we may wish them success in new beginnings.
sentences.zh: 新的一年開始時，我們可以祝他們的新起點一切順利。

sentences.text: Hoping the New Year and your new beginnings bring you much success.
sentences.zh: 希望新的一年和新的開始為你帶來許多成功。

sentences.text: And finally, we can tell our friends how much they mean to us as we look forward to another year.
sentences.zh: 最後，在迎接新的一年時，我們可以告訴朋友他們對我們有多重要。

sentences.text: Here is one way to do just that: Looking forward to another year of being friends with you.
sentences.zh: 以下就是一種寫法：期待再和你當一年的朋友。
